lines.en: I pace slowly before the hall
Scrolls are stacked in a small hill on the desk
I straighten my cap

lines.zh: 我走到柱子那边又折回
lines.en: I walk to the pillar and back

lines.zh: 阎魔殿的地板被踩得发亮
lines.en: The floor of Yemma's hall shines from use
I flip a page of the register as I walk
My steps are heavy, the floor echoes

lines.zh: 我绕过一堆没审完的魂
lines.en: I step around a pile of unjudged souls

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看那口大锅
lines.en: I glance at the great cauldron
My boots tap out a rhythm

lines.zh: 我坐在案后，手撑着下颌
lines.en: I sit behind the desk, chin in hand
I cannot be bothered to lift the brush

lines.zh: 我在想今天排了几个人
lines.en: I wonder how many are queued today
This cap is a little tight
I close my eyes and listen to the wind outside
I open a scroll and close it again
After so many, even I get tired
I press my brow with one hand
I give a very low yawn

lines.zh: 我在等下一个跪下的魂
lines.en: I wait for the next soul to kneel
I leaf through yesterday's old cases
I shift the inkstone aside

lines.zh: 我数着排队的魂有几个
lines.en: I count the souls in the queue
My shoulders will not relax
The incense in the hall is nearly out
I look up at that cauldron
You are still alive, you came to the wrong place
Stand straight, do not tremble

lines.zh: 我看过太多像你这样的
lines.en: I have seen too many like you
Your name is not in the register
I raise my eyes to you, slowly
What do you have to declare
First tell me what you did
Do not expect me to bend the rules
I judge thousands a day
Think carefully before you speak
Here I listen only to truth
Your complexion is not bad
Ouch, even this body feels pain
Who interrupts the judgment
My judge's cap has gone crooked
I steady myself on the edge of the desk
That blow was not light at all
Three thousand years of old bones
I draw one slow breath

lines.zh: 我的道行也不是白修的
lines.en: My cultivation is not for nothing
Move again and I change the verdict
No eating in this hall
What is that for, put it away

lines.zh: 我审案的时候不看这些
lines.en: I do not look at such things while judging
You mean to bribe Yemma
That smell stands out in this hall
I often forget to eat at all
Not even on the desk

lines.zh: 我这一口下去就要误事
lines.en: One bite and I would ruin my work
You do know how to pick your moment
We will talk once I close the hall
You bumped the judge's desk
This body of mine is not light
Stand back, do not crowd
You stepped on a scroll
I reach up to hold my cap
The hall is small, bear with it
The bump knocked my brush crooked
Nothing may be disorderly here
Step back beyond the line
Crowd me again and I dock your merit
Yemma does not discuss such things
My companions are these scrolls
There is no place for that in this hall
Three thousand years, and I have been alone
I have noted what you said
This should not be raised here
All my time goes to judgment
Do not steer toward that again
I shake my head and swallow the words
Call the next soul up

lines.zh: 我伸手把落地的卷宗捡起来
lines.en: I reach down and pick up the fallen scroll
This one is not yet judged
I smooth it out bit by bit
Whatever falls must go back
I pick up a broken brush
This brush is useless now
I stack the register back up
This page has been stepped on
I fold it carefully
I sigh, more work again
Next, step forward
Your soul is a little heavy
I lift my brush, ready to write
I can tally what is on your account
Do not move, stand right there
I can see everything about you
I will ask a few more questions about this

lines.zh: 卷宗翻到你的那一页了
lines.en: The scroll is open at your page
Do not think you can be vague
Lift your face so I can see it
Your case is somewhat interesting
First let me see where you come from
Your name is written crooked
Stand in the light
One stroke of my brush decides you
I raise an eyebrow
I have seen this name before
Do not look elsewhere, look at me
I watch you as I write

lines.zh: 你说的和你做的不一样
lines.en: What you say and what you did differ
I turn to the next page
This account is not settled

lines.zh: 我把你的罪状一条条排开
lines.en: I lay your charges out one by one
Do you have another name
I have judged tougher than you

lines.zh: 坐在这个位置不能心软
lines.en: In this seat one cannot soften
I stop the brush tip
Let me see how long you can hold
Your accounts are kept very messily
I put the brush down and look at you properly
In your life you did three things
I am not rushing, the queue is long

lines.zh: 你说话的时候眼睛在闪
lines.en: Your eyes flicker while you speak
I push the scroll forward

lines.zh: 这一条我还没想好怎么判
lines.en: I have not decided how to rule on this one
Which side do you want me to see
My verdict must be written clearly

lines.zh: 你还有一次解释的机会
lines.en: You have one more chance to explain
I slam a palm on the desk
I raise a hand and pin you down
No fighting in this hall
Let me share a little of my strength
This palm is not for judgment
Move again and I change the verdict
I push you out the hall doors
I am only making you stand still
The rules are the biggest thing here
I shove you back from the desk
My palm is heavier than it looks
That palm did not use its weight
I pin you against the hall pillar

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，殿里安静了
lines.en: I cough once and the hall goes quiet
King Yemma is here
Many souls are queued today
I settle back behind the great desk
The scrolls are stacked to my knees
I straighten my robe
Verdicts come one at a time

lines.zh: 我的帽子见证了三千年
lines.en: My cap has witnessed three thousand years
I will judge this batch a little faster
I can see the length of your life
I rest my brush by the inkstone
The hall doors close behind me
Get behind, do not cut in
I have these accounts in my head

lines.zh: 这里没有冤枉，只有早晚
lines.en: There is no injustice here, only sooner or later
Bring in the next batch
I roll my sleeve a little
Right, then let us begin
My patience has limits
Line up one behind another
The flame has reached my robe
I fell from behind the desk
Water stuffs up my chest

lines.zh: 爆炸震得殿里的卷宗全飞了
lines.en: The blast sent every scroll in the hall flying

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的帽子上
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my cap

lines.zh: 这股术力竟然压到我身上
lines.en: This magic actually weighed on me

lines.zh: 我审了一整天，什么都没吃
lines.en: I judged all day and ate nothing
Lightning fell on my shoulder
The hall beneath me is gone
